messages:
Priya: Quick sync  Mode Abstraction Factory follow-up. I sketched a small prototype that centralizes how we create adapters for hosted/dedicated/private. Aim: single decision point for capability discovery + consistent lifecycle hints (pooled / lease / ephemeral) and explicit secret ownership flags.

Priya: Prototype surface:
```
Factory.resolve(profile, route_hint) -> { adapter_handle, lifecycle_hint, capability_manifest, secret_mode }
// secret_mode: 'tenant'|'factory'|'sidecar'
```
Factory also exposes minimal fallback adapter that indicates capability_minimal so callers can degrade gracefully.

Dan: This helps, but ownership boundaries for KMS matter. If we hand out pooled adapters for Dedicated, who rotates keys and emits audit events? If Factory proxies KMS calls for hosted, that centralizes audit but breaks Private guarantees. We need explicit lifecycle+ownership mappings per mode.

Lin: Agreed. Proposal: canonical secret_mode values documented in manifest. For Private: enforce 'tenant' or 'sidecar' only (no factory proxy). For Hosted: allow 'factory' proxy for operational simplicity. Add jittered renewals and per-tenant short leases for pooled adapters so we don't keep long-lived cross-tenant credentials.

Alex: Observability rules: adapter_handle must contain stable adapter_id and a human-friendly mode label. We'll tag metrics with adapter.id, adapter.mode, adapter.lifespan. Also inject adapter_id into trace spans so latency attribution and hot-paths show up consistently across pooled vs ephemeral adapters.

Eva: Rollout semantics question: how should model variant rollouts interact with factory-level routing? Example: hosted routes to model-v2, dedicated remains on model-v1. We need a per-tenant sticky pin + global override for experiments. Also include a 'speculative' flag so requests can opt-in to trial behavior without changing tenant routing.

Priya: Good points. Updated behavior:
- Factory.resolve accepts hints: {tenant_id, force_variant?, speculative:Boolean} and returns pinned adapter if sticky exists.
- capability_manifest includes {features:[], supported_variants:[], fallback_order:[]} as a serialized blob.
- secret_mode enforced by runtime; factory refuses to create adapter when tenant privileges mismatch.

Dan: Failure modes: if Factory is overloaded, it should return a probe adapter that responds quickly with capability_minimal + error_code 'factory_unavailable' so upstream can switch to local degraded path. Avoid making Factory a single op that blocks request latency.

Lin: Add a lease-renewer component for pooled adapters that spreads refreshes with randomized windows to avoid thundering herd on token rotation. Also log renewer jitter metrics.

Alex: I'll add telemetry conventions in a short PR: adapter.id in trace attributes, a metric prefix adapter.latency.{mode}, and a tag lifecycle=pooled|ephemeral. Also we'll surface adapter.capability_manifest hash in logs for quick cross-correlation.

deploy-bot: deploy: mode-abstraction-factory-proto v0.2 -> staging (canary) :rocket:

Eva: Suggest adding a tiny cross-mode eval harness in staging to simulate host->dedicated->private fallbacks and pinned rollouts. Catches a lot of edge cases.

Priya: Agreed. Action items:
- Priya: update RFC with lifecycle matrix and secret_mode policy (PR by EOD)
- Lin: lease-renewer jitter impl + tests
- Alex: telemetry/convention PR + tracing shim
- Eva: small eval harness & experiment plan
- Dan: draft failure-domain playbook for Factory outages

Priya: Thanks all. I'll post the updated RFC section and link the prototype repo in the thread when ready. :thumbsup:
